```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
```

```{r load-ec-file}
# Load with proper headers
ec_data <- readxl::read_excel("data/ec_cas.xlsx", skip = 1) |>
  # Remove last empty column
  dplyr::select(1:5) |>
  # Rename columns
  dplyr::rename(
    Compound = 1,
    CAS = 2,
    MP = 3,
    InChIKey = 4,
    SMILES = 5
  ) |>
  # Remove MP column since we don't need it
  dplyr::select(-MP)

cat("Rows:", nrow(ec_data), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(ec_data), "\n")
print(ec_data)
```


```{r chembl-extraction, message=TRUE}
chembl_results <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:nrow(ec_data)) {
  compound <- ec_data$Compound[i]
  inchikey <- ec_data$InChIKey[i]
  
  tryCatch({
    url <- paste0("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chembl/api/data/molecule/", inchikey)
    
    req <- httr2::request(url) |> httr2::req_headers(Accept = "application/json")
    response <- httr2::req_perform(req)
    parsed <- jsonlite::fromJSON(httr2::resp_body_string(response), flatten = TRUE)
    
    chembl_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(chembl_results,
      data.frame(
        Compound = compound,
        ChEMBL_ID = parsed$molecule_chembl_id,
        MW = parsed$molecule_properties$full_mwt,
        PSA = parsed$molecule_properties$psa,
        HBD = as.integer(parsed$molecule_properties$hbd),
        HBA = as.integer(parsed$molecule_properties$hba),
        LogP = parsed$molecule_properties$alogp
      ))
    message(paste("Found:", compound, "→", parsed$molecule_chembl_id))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("No match for:", compound, "-", e$message))
    chembl_results <<- dplyr::bind_rows(chembl_results,
      data.frame(Compound = compound,
                 ChEMBL_ID = NA, MW = NA, PSA = NA,
                 HBD = NA, HBA = NA, LogP = NA))
  })
}

cat("=== ChEMBL EXTRACTION SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Matched:", sum(!is.na(chembl_results$ChEMBL_ID)), "/", nrow(chembl_results), "\n")
print(chembl_results)
```
```{r pubchem-fallback-ec}
missing_ec <- ec_data |>
  dplyr::filter(Compound %in% c("PCB-138", "PCDD 67", "PCDD 73", 
                                 "PCDF 124", "PCDF 131", "PCDF 134", "PCDF 135"))

pubchem_ec <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:nrow(missing_ec)) {
  compound <- missing_ec$Compound[i]
  smiles <- missing_ec$SMILES[i]
  
  tryCatch({
    url <- paste0("https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/smiles/",
                  utils::URLencode(smiles),
                  "/property/MolecularWeight,XLogP,TPSA,HBondDonorCount,HBondAcceptorCount/JSON")
    
    req <- httr2::request(url)
    response <- httr2::req_perform(req)
    parsed <- jsonlite::fromJSON(httr2::resp_body_string(response), flatten = TRUE)
    props <- parsed$PropertyTable$Properties
    
    pubchem_ec <- dplyr::bind_rows(pubchem_ec,
      data.frame(
        Compound = compound,
        ChEMBL_ID = NA,
        MW = as.character(props$MolecularWeight),
        PSA = as.character(props$TPSA),
        HBD = as.integer(props$HBondDonorCount),
        HBA = as.integer(props$HBondAcceptorCount),
        LogP = as.character(props$XLogP),
        Source = "PubChem"
      ))
    message(paste("PubChem found:", compound))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("PubChem failed for:", compound, "-", e$message))
    pubchem_ec <<- dplyr::bind_rows(pubchem_ec,
      data.frame(Compound = compound, ChEMBL_ID = NA,
                 MW = NA, PSA = NA, HBD = NA, HBA = NA,
                 LogP = NA, Source = "Not found"))
  })
}

print(pubchem_ec)
```
```{r combine-ec}
# Add source column to ChEMBL results
chembl_results <- chembl_results |>
  dplyr::mutate(Source = ifelse(!is.na(ChEMBL_ID), "ChEMBL", "Not found"))

# Combine ChEMBL and PubChem results
ec_combined <- chembl_results |>
  dplyr::rows_update(
    pubchem_ec |> dplyr::select(-ChEMBL_ID),
    by = "Compound"
  )

# Join with original ec_data to get CAS and SMILES
ec_final <- ec_data |>
  dplyr::left_join(ec_combined, by = "Compound")

cat("=== COMBINED SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Total compounds:", nrow(ec_final), "\n")
cat("With MW:", sum(!is.na(ec_final$MW)), "\n")
cat("With PSA:", sum(!is.na(ec_final$PSA)), "\n")
cat("With LogP:", sum(!is.na(ec_final$LogP)), "\n")
cat("Missing all properties:", sum(is.na(ec_final$MW)), "\n")

print(ec_final |> dplyr::select(Compound, ChEMBL_ID, MW, PSA, HBD, HBA, LogP, Source))
```


```{r add-pcdd73}
# Add PCDD 73 manually from PubChem CID 37270
ec_final <- ec_final |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    MW = ifelse(Compound == "PCDD 73", "425.3", MW),
    PSA = ifelse(Compound == "PCDD 73", "18.5", PSA),
    HBD = ifelse(Compound == "PCDD 73", 0L, HBD),
    HBA = ifelse(Compound == "PCDD 73", 2L, HBA),
    LogP = ifelse(Compound == "PCDD 73", "7.5", LogP),
    Source = ifelse(Compound == "PCDD 73", "PubChem CID 37270", Source)
  )

cat("FINAL SUMMARY\n")
cat("Total compounds:", nrow(ec_final), "\n")
cat("With MW:", sum(!is.na(ec_final$MW)), "\n")
cat("With PSA:", sum(!is.na(ec_final$PSA)), "\n")
cat("With LogP:", sum(!is.na(ec_final$LogP)), "\n")

print(ec_final |> dplyr::select(Compound, ChEMBL_ID, MW, PSA, HBD, HBA, LogP, Source))
```



```{r load-opera-ec}
opera_ec <- readr::read_csv("data/opera_ec_data.csv")

cat("Rows:", nrow(opera_ec), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(opera_ec), "\n")
print(names(opera_ec))
```

```{r merge-opera-ec}
# Check what came back
cat("Unique INPUT values:", length(unique(opera_ec$INPUT)), "\n")
cat("Unique CASRN values:", length(unique(opera_ec$CASRN)), "\n")

# Clean and deduplicate
opera_ec_clean <- opera_ec |>
  dplyr::select(
    INPUT,
    CASRN,
    pKa_acid_pred = OPERA_PKAA_OPERA_PRED,
    pKa_base_pred = OPERA_PKAB_OPERA_PRED,
    LogD74_pred = LOGD7.4
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    pKa_acid_pred = dplyr::na_if(pKa_acid_pred, "N/A"),
    pKa_base_pred = dplyr::na_if(pKa_base_pred, "N/A"),
    LogD74_pred = dplyr::na_if(LogD74_pred, "N/A"),
    pKa_acid_pred = as.numeric(pKa_acid_pred),
    pKa_base_pred = as.numeric(pKa_base_pred),
    LogD74_pred = as.numeric(LogD74_pred)
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct(CASRN, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("After deduplication:", nrow(opera_ec_clean), "rows\n")

# Merge with ec_final by CAS
ec_final <- ec_final |>
  dplyr::left_join(opera_ec_clean |> dplyr::select(CASRN, pKa_acid_pred, pKa_base_pred, LogD74_pred),
                   by = c("CAS" = "CASRN"))

cat("\n=== OPERA MERGE SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Compounds with predicted pKa acid:", sum(!is.na(ec_final$pKa_acid_pred)), "/", nrow(ec_final), "\n")
cat("Compounds with predicted pKa base:", sum(!is.na(ec_final$pKa_base_pred)), "/", nrow(ec_final), "\n")
cat("Compounds with predicted LogD7.4:", sum(!is.na(ec_final$LogD74_pred)), "/", nrow(ec_final), "\n")

print(ec_final |> dplyr::select(Compound, CAS, pKa_acid_pred, pKa_base_pred, LogD74_pred))
```



```{r type-and-save}
ec_final <- ec_final |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Type = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(pKa_acid_pred) & !is.na(pKa_base_pred) ~ "AMPHOLYTE",
      !is.na(pKa_acid_pred) & is.na(pKa_base_pred)  ~ "ACID",
      is.na(pKa_acid_pred) & !is.na(pKa_base_pred)  ~ "BASE",
      is.na(pKa_acid_pred) & is.na(pKa_base_pred)   ~ "NEUTRAL",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

cat("TYPE SUMMARY\n")
ec_final |> dplyr::count(Type) |> print()

cat("\nFINAL DATASET SUMMARY\n")
cat("Total compounds:", nrow(ec_final), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(ec_final), "\n")
print(names(ec_final))

saveRDS(ec_final, "data/ec_dataset.rds")
readr::write_csv(ec_final, "data/ec_dataset.csv")
cat("\nDataset saved!\n")
```
